events.location: Fever Skygate | Exhibition and Immersive Experience centre
events.description: ⭐ Dinos Alive is a dinosaur exhibition featuring life-size animated replicas in an immersive Jurassic venue. Walk alongside the massive creatures that roamed our world millions of years ago! Tickets for Birthday Celebrations at Dinos Alive 🎫 Birthday ticket - includes entry to the experience and birthday room for the celebration 🎫 VIP Birthday ticket - includes entry to the experience and birthday room for the celebration, virtual reality and a Dinos Alive poster * Please always select the 'Birthday Room' option when booking so that we can ensure that the room is reserved exclusively for your celebration. ** A minimum of 7 tickets required for a birthday booking. Highlights 🌲 Travel back to the Jurassic in a thematic park full of realistic dinosaurs—see these magnificent creatures in their natural habitat! 🦕 Come face to face with 40+ specimens of moving replicas: T-rex, Stegosaurus, Ankylosaurus, Velociraptors, and many more 🦈 Dive into the depths of the seas and interact with Jurassic sea giants in a unique virtual aquarium 😮 Learn more about the Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous periods in a fun and interactive way 👓 Immerse yourself to the fullest with a captivating VR experience (for an additional fee) 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Kids can enjoy a “Budding Experts” interactive space, where they can become palaeontologists and tame the most iconic dinosaurs General Info 📅 Dates and times: select your date & time directly in the ticket selector ⏳ Duration: approx. 60-90 minutes. You will have the room booked for you for 30 minutes 📍 Location: Fever Skygate | Exhibition and Experience Centre, 30-34 The Circuit, Skygate, Brisbane Airport 👤 Age requirement: all ages are welcome! ♿ Accessibility: the venue is wheelchair accessible ❓ Please consult the FAQs of this experience here ❓ Please contact us at dinos.brisbane@exhibitionhub.com if you have any questions Birthday Celebrations ⏳ You will have access to the Birthday Room for 30 minutes 🎂 2 soft drinks per guest are included in the birthday package 👥 Please note that any person entering the exhibition or the birthday room needs a valid ticket 👥 If you are unsure about the number of attendees, please select the minimum; you can add more attendees upon arrival ⚠ Tickets are not refundable Description Go back millions of years to a land ruled by giants!
